title: A Inventory for the Postcards
author: Astrid Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Okafor, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
